and ENTRUST_ID in

mapper.update: UPDATE BID_ORDER SET IS_CANCEL = 'Y',REMARK = #{remark} WHERE BID_ID = #{bidId}
UPDATE BID_ORDER_BID_PRICE SET IS_CANCEL = 'Y' WHERE BID_ID = #{bidId}
mapper.select: select bo.FINPROD_ID finprodId, fp.FINPROD_MARKET_ID finprodMarketId, fp.FINPROD_ABBR finprodAbbr, bo.OUR_TRADER ourTrader, mcct.TRADER_NAME ourTraderName, fpi.TENDER_TARGET tenderTarget/*招标标的*/, fp.CCY ccy, CASE WHEN fpi.ISSUE_CLASS = '02' AND fpi.TENDER_TYPE IN ('01', '02') THEN fpi.ISSUE_DATE WHEN (fpi.ISSUE_CLASS = '02' AND (fpi.TENDER_TYPE IS NULL OR fpi.TENDER_TYPE IN ('03', '04'))) OR fpi.ISSUE_CLASS = '03' THEN fpi.TENDER_SDATE END AS bidDateStart/*投标日 开始*/, CASE WHEN fpi.ISSUE_CLASS = '02' AND fpi.TENDER_TYPE IN ('01', '02') THEN fpi.ISSUE_DATE WHEN (fpi.ISSUE_CLASS = '02' AND (fpi.TENDER_TYPE IS NULL OR fpi.TENDER_TYPE IN ('03', '04'))) OR fpi.ISSUE_CLASS = '03' THEN fpi.TENDER_SDATE END AS bidDateEnd/*投标日 结束*/, bo.PAY_DATE payDate/*缴款日*/, fpi.PAY_EDATE payEdate/*缴款截止日*/, bo.ASSIGN_REGDATE assignRegdate/*债权债务登记日*/, bo.ONMARKET_DATE listingDate/*上市日*/, bo.BID_MODLE AS biddingMethod/*投标方式*/, bo.PAY_TYPE AS payType/*缴款方式*/, ee.ENTRUST_NUM AS etrBidPriceTotal/*指令投标券面总额*/, bo.WIN_PRIN_AMT AS totalBiddingNum/*汇总投标券面总额*/, bo.WIN_PRIN_AMT AS bidPriceTotal/*券面总额*/, case when fpi.TENDER_TARGET = '01' then bo.WIN_PRICE * 100 when fpi.TENDER_TARGET = '02' then bo.WIN_PRICE when fpi.TENDER_TARGET = '03' then bo.WIN_PRICE * 10000 end winPrice/*中标标位*/, bo.UNIT_INT /*应计利息*/, bo.SETT_FEE_AMT settFeeAmt/*结算服务费*/, bo.REMARK AS remark/*备注*/, bobp.ENTRUST_ID, bobp.PORTFOLIO_ID, pp.PORTFOLIO_NAME, bobp.THE_WIN_PRIN_AMT /*汇总投标券面总额*/, bobp.SETT_FEE_AMT/*结算服务费*/, bobp.TRADE_AMT/*交易金额*/, bobp.INT_AMT/*应计利息总额*/, bobp.PAYABLE_AMOUNT/*缴款金额*/, bobp.BID_PRICE/*标位*/, eed.INV_AIM/*业务模式*/, eed.SEC_ACCT_ID, ssai.SEC_ACCT_NAME, bo.dip_Type dipType/*分配方式*/, bo.dip_Type adjustStrategy/*调整策略*/, ee.INV_MANAGER_ID invManagerId, su.REAL_NAME invManagerName, ROWNUM rn from BID_ORDER bo left join BID_ORDER_BID_PRICE bobp on bo.BID_ID = bobp.BID_ID left join PTL_PORTFOLIO pp on bobp.PORTFOLIO_ID = pp.PORTFOLIO_ID LEFT JOIN ETR_ENTRUST ee ON ee.ENTRUST_ID = bobp.ENTRUST_ID left join ETR_ENTRUST_DETAIL eed on bobp.ENTRUST_ID = eed.ENTRUST_ID and bobp.PORTFOLIO_ID = eed.PORTFOLIO_ID left join FIN_PRODUCT fp on fp.FINPROD_ID = bo.FINPROD_ID left join FIN_PRODUCT_ISSUE fpi on fp.FINPROD_ID = fpi.FINPROD_ID left join SYS_DATADICT_LIST sdl_sd on sdl_sd.DICT_CODE = 'SECRATE_DATA' and sdl_sd.ITEM_CODE = fpi.INT_RATE_ID left join MST_CFETS_CUSTOMER_INFO mcci on mcci.PARTY_ID = bo.OU_PARTY_ID left join MST_CFETS_CUSTOMER_TRADER mcct on mcct.TRADER_ID = bo.OUR_TRADER left join STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO ssai on ssai.SEC_ACCT_ID = eed.SEC_ACCT_ID left join SYS_USER su on su.USER_NAME = ee.INV_MANAGER_ID where bo.BID_ID = #{bidId} union all select bo.FINPROD_ID finprodId, fp.FINPROD_MARKET_ID finprodMarketId, '02') THEN fpi.ISSUE_DATE WHEN (fpi.ISSUE_CLASS = '02' AND (fpi.TENDER_TYPE IS NULL OR fpi.TENDER_TYPE IN ('03', '04'))) OR fpi.ISSUE_CLASS = '03' THEN fpi.TENDER_SDATE END AS bidDateStart/*投标日 开始*/, fpi.ISSUE_CLASS = '03' THEN fpi.TENDER_SDATE END AS bidDateEnd/*投标日 结束*/, bo.PAY_DATE payDate/*缴款日*/, fpi.PAY_EDATE payEdate/*缴款截止日*/, bo.ASSIGN_REGDATE assignRegdate/*债权债务登记日*/, bo.ONMARKET_DATE listingDate/*上市日*/, bo.BID_MODLE AS biddingMethod/*投标方式*/, bo.PAY_TYPE AS payType/*缴款方式*/, ee.ENTRUST_NUM AS etrBidPriceTotal/*指令投标券面总额*/, bo.WIN_PRIN_AMT AS totalBiddingNum/*汇总投标券面总额*/, bo.WIN_PRIN_AMT AS bidPriceTotal/*券面总额*/, case when fpi.TENDER_TARGET = '01' then bo.WIN_PRICE * 100 when fpi.TENDER_TARGET = '02' then bo.WIN_PRICE when fpi.TENDER_TARGET = '03' then bo.WIN_PRICE * 10000 end winPrice/*中标标位*/, bo.UNIT_INT /*应计利息*/, bo.SETT_FEE_AMT settFeeAmt/*结算服务费*/, bo.REMARK AS remark/*备注*/, bobp.ENTRUST_ID, bobp.PORTFOLIO_ID, pp.PORTFOLIO_NAME, bobp.THE_WIN_PRIN_AMT /*汇总投标券面总额*/, bobp.SETT_FEE_AMT/*结算服务费*/, bobp.TRADE_AMT/*交易金额*/, bobp.INT_AMT/*应计利息总额*/, bobp.PAYABLE_AMOUNT/*缴款金额*/, bobp.BID_PRICE/*标位*/, eed.INV_AIM/*业务模式*/, eed.SEC_ACCT_ID, ssai.SEC_ACCT_NAME, bo.dip_Type dipType/*分配方式*/, bo.dip_Type adjustStrategy/*调整策略*/, ee.INV_MANAGER_ID invManagerId, su.REAL_NAME invManagerName, ROWNUM rn from WFL_BID_ORDER bo left join WFL_BID_ORDER_BID_PRICE bobp on bo.BID_ID = bobp.BID_ID left join PTL_PORTFOLIO pp on bobp.PORTFOLIO_ID = pp.PORTFOLIO_ID LEFT JOIN ETR_ENTRUST ee ON ee.ENTRUST_ID = bobp.ENTRUST_ID left join ETR_ENTRUST_DETAIL eed on bobp.ENTRUST_ID = eed.ENTRUST_ID and bobp.PORTFOLIO_ID = eed.PORTFOLIO_ID left join FIN_PRODUCT fp on fp.FINPROD_ID = bo.FINPROD_ID left join FIN_PRODUCT_ISSUE fpi on fp.FINPROD_ID = fpi.FINPROD_ID left join SYS_DATADICT_LIST sdl_sd on sdl_sd.DICT_CODE = 'SECRATE_DATA' and sdl_sd.ITEM_CODE = fpi.INT_RATE_ID left join MST_CFETS_CUSTOMER_INFO mcci on mcci.PARTY_ID = bo.OU_PARTY_ID left join MST_CFETS_CUSTOMER_TRADER mcct on mcct.TRADER_ID = bo.OUR_TRADER left join STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO ssai on ssai.SEC_ACCT_ID = eed.SEC_ACCT_ID left join SYS_USER su on su.USER_NAME = ee.INV_MANAGER_ID where bo.BID_ID = #{bidId}

select NVl(fri.BENCHMARK_ID_ACCURACY, 1) * nvl(fri.COEFFICIENT, 1)*nvl(miri.INT_RATE,0) + NVl(fri.SPREAD_RATE, 0) from FIN_RATE_INFO fri left join MST_INT_RATE_INFO miri on fri.BENCHMARK_ID = miri.INT_RATE_ID where fri.EFF_DATE <= to_date('yyyy-MM-dd',#{sysDate}) and miri.EFF_DATE <= to_date('yyyy-MM-dd',#{sysDate}) and fri.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} and ROWNUM = 1 order by fri.EFF_DATE desc ,miri.EFF_DATE desc
